d: After weeks of bickering over seat-sharing for the high-voltage Assembly polls in Uttar Pradesh, Congress and Samajwadi Party leaders met in Delhi on Monday, but the meeting lasted only 20 minutes. Both parties have picked four leaders for the seat-sharing talks. The Samajwadi Party has chosen veteran leader Ram Gopal Yadav, MPs Iqra Choudhary and Rajeev Rai, and state party chief Shyam Lal Pal for the negotiations. The Congress has selected AICC in-charge for Uttar Pradesh Rajendra Pal Gautam, state party chief Aradhna Mishra, working president Imran Masood, and MLA Virendra Chaudhary.…
